title: Exclude the local build output from the lint script
objective: npm run lint (eslint . --ignore-pattern dist --ignore-pattern .next) lints the ignored .sites-runtime/portable-build/.next output when a portable build exists locally, and reported 12 require()-import errors there at adoption on 2026-09-20 while the source was clean. project.json's validation runs eslint with --ignore-pattern .sites-runtime for that reason; the package.json script should carry the same ignore so npm run lint means the same thing everywhere.
acceptance: package.json's lint script ignores .sites-runtime (or an eslint config ignores it) and npm run lint passes with a local portable build present.
project.json's validation entry goes back to npm run lint once it does.
non_goals: No change to what the suites test.
No merge, deployment, live-data mutation, or account change unless separately authorized.

handoff.next_action: Add .sites-runtime to the lint script's ignore patterns and rerun npm run lint with the local build present.
